title: Recover interrupted reader journey tasks and unify composite task status

commits.message: fix(journey): recover interrupted reader journey tasks

user_summary: 修复阅读旅程异常中断后假运行、无法恢复，以及任务中心状态/进度/CTA不一致的问题。
technical_summary: Isolate Reader Journey worker failures, recover orphan running journeys on Sidecar startup as JOURNEY_INTERRUPTED retryable, allow resume, and unify task-center lifecycle/progress/CTA so Parent succeeded cannot show 查看结果 while Journey is active or interrupted.

Task center shows journey progress and 查看进度/查看详情 correctly
